name: EVA — Agentic Accounting Platform
description: Visiontype: the accountant's day starts in their portfolio while EVA — a team of agents — runs the recurring work across every client (bookkeeping, reconciliation, controlling, VAT, month-end and payroll). People review EVA's drafts in one ranked queue, make the judgement calls and advise clients with a cash forecast and budget they can share. Everything is logged and traceable. Mock data only.
